description_en: Releases the public endpoint of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 释放MongoDB实例的公网连接地址
name: ReleasePublicNetworkAddress

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the mongos, shard, or Configserver node in the sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is valid only if you set the DBInstanceId parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to view the ID of the mongos, shard, or Configserver node
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID、Shard节点ID或ConfigServer节点ID。

当DBInstanceId传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询Mongos/Shard/ConfigServer节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The public endpoint type. Valid values:

SRV

Normal

This parameter is valid only when you want to release an SRV endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
公网地址类型，可选值：
SRV
Normal
当释放的连接地址是SRV地址时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: connection_type
